title: Stage Validation
description: Result of adversarial validation from exploit agent. Proves or disproves a finding with a minimal repro + sanitizer, then records the patch.

finding_id.description: Case ID from the casefile ledger

status.description: Validation status: confirmed (repro triggered), killed (failed), or reported (patched)

technique_used.description: The technique used to reproduce/validate: asan (AddressSanitizer), ubsan (UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer), valgrind (memcheck), minimal-repro (standalone repro without sanitizer), manual-review (static evidence chain only)

detection_method.description: How the vulnerability was detected (ASAN report pointing at sink line, UBSAN undefined-behavior report, crash backtrace, deterministic wrong output, etc.)

build_config.description: Exact build command + flags + source used for the repro (e.g. gcc -fsanitize=address,undefined -g repro.c -o repro). Required when a repro was compiled.

sanitizer_result.description: Raw sanitizer/runtime output proving the bug (e.g. 'ERROR: AddressSanitizer: heap-buffer-overflow on address 0x602000000014 at pc ... WRITE of size 8'). Required when confirmed via sanitizer.

poc_path.description: Path to the PoC/repro file on disk (required when confirmed)

run_log.description: Summary of the repro output including exit code (required when confirmed)

evidence_extracted.description: Evidence that proves the finding (crash backtrace, memory corruption report, leaked data, privilege change observed)

kill_reason.description: Reason the finding was killed (required when killed): sanitizer_no_trigger (repro compiled but no sanitizer error), compile_failed (target/repro cannot be built), no_real_impact (bug exists but no security impact)

refinement_attempts.description: Number of refinement attempts before success or kill
